cases.title: Add single note via Add note button
cases.description: Clicking the "Add note" button (id="add", class="add", data-testid="add-note-button") creates a new note appended to the document body as a <div> element with the class "note", containing a visible, empty <textarea> (data-testid="note-textarea") for user input.

cases.title: Add multiple notes via rapid clicks on Add note button
cases.description: Performing multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button creates a separate note for each click, with each note containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown rendering
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown into the textarea, the content is dynamically rendered in the main display area in real-time with proper HTML formatting.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown handling and raw input display
cases.description: Verify that invalid Markdown does not cause crashes or errors, and displays the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button.

cases.title: Immediate local storage update during editing
cases.description: Verify that all changes made during editing are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state of the note.

cases.title: Create new note entering edit mode upon page load
cases.description: Verify that when the app page loads and the user clicks the Add note button (data-testid="add-note-button"), the new note immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden.

cases.title: Switch between edit and view modes using the Edit button
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the Edit button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), which toggles the visibility such that in view mode the main content area is visible and the textarea is hidden, and in edit mode this behavior is reversed.

cases.title: Automatically save typed changes to local storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Remove targeted note from the DOM upon clicking the delete button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") associated with a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM so it no longer appears on the page.

cases.title: Remove corresponding entry from localStorage upon clicking the delete button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") associated with a note removes the corresponding entry from localStorage to ensure it is no longer part of the stored notes array.

cases.title: Retrieve and render saved notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: Verify that when the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves saved notes from localStorage and dynamically creates a div element with the class note including tools with Edit and Delete buttons, a main div (data-testid="note-main"), and a textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), with the content displayed in the main div and the textarea hidden by default for notes with content.

cases.title: Render notes with no content showing textarea and hiding main div on page load
cases.description: Verify that for notes retrieved from localStorage that have no content, the application shows the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") and hides the main div (data-testid="note-main") allowing immediate editing.

cases.title: Display no notes when localStorage is empty on page load
cases.description: Verify that if localStorage is empty when the Notes App webpage loads, no notes are shown.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and cases are fully covered, valid, and well-aligned without any blockers or missing scenarios.

analysis.analysis: Requirement R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: clicking the Add note button creates and appends a <div> with class "note" containing a visible empty <textarea>, and supporting multiple rapid clicks to create separate notes. Requirement R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: editing Markdown content dynamically rendering in real-time in the main display area, handling complex/invalid Markdown syntax without crashes/errors by displaying raw input upon exiting edit mode via the "Edit" button, and reflecting changes immediately in local storage. Requirement R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: creating a new note entering edit mode with a visible textarea and hidden main content area upon page load, switching between edit and view modes via the "Edit" button toggling visibility of the main area and textarea, and automatically saving typed changes to local storage. Requirement R-4 contains multiple distinct behaviors: clicking the delete button removes the targeted note immediately from the DOM, and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: retrieving saved notes from localStorage on webpage load to dynamically create note elements with tools, main, and textarea, rendering notes with content in the main div and textarea hidden by default, showing the textarea and hiding the main div for notes with no content, showing no notes if localStorage is empty, and using the notes variable retrieved via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')). All requirements exhibit normal and abnormal paths as explicitly stated in the text.
